// CASE dart_top_const_vs_field_implicit_this expect=pass
const width = 1;
class Importer {
  Importer(this.width);
  final int width;
  Future<void> run(List<int> items) => mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save);
}
// CASE dart_top_final_vs_local_var expect=pass
final limit = 1;
Future<void> localVar(List<int> items, Config config) async {
  var limit = config.limit;
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, limit, save);
}
// CASE dart_top_final_vs_getter expect=pass
final concurrency = 1;
class Pool {
  int get concurrency => 4;
  Future<void> run(List<int> items) => mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, save);
}
// CASE end expect=pass
